blurb: Southside Ballet Studio provides dance education in various styles including ballet, tap, jazz, lyrical, acrobatic arts, contemporary, and pointe. Classes are arranged by age and skill level. The studio also offers summer dance camps and mainstage performances including Nutcracker, Cinderella, and a May recital.
extraNote: Yearly registration fee $50 per family, non-refundable · Tuition paid in 10 monthly payments September-May, due by 10th with $10 late fee after · No refunds or carryover of tuition; payment due whether absent or present · Studio closed when Isle of Wight County Schools close for bad weather · Costume payments non-refundable once paid; due in installments or full by Nov 1, 2026
